prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high-fidelity flat screenshot design proposal for Cairn, an existing local desktop coding agent. Landscape desktop window 1440 x 900, straight-on full viewport, no device, no perspective, no shadows outside window, no marketing poster, no floating decorative objects. Design references: Claude Desktop's calm surfaces and generous yet disciplined typography; Codex desktop's project/chat organization; official DeepSeek Harness's compact agent controls and expandable process. This is an operational tool used for hours. System sans-serif UI including Chinese; no serif in chat. Palette fixed: warm off-white main #faf9f5, slightly darker quiet warm-gray sidebar #f1f0eb, ink #252420, subdued #74716a, hairline #e5e2da, terracotta #c47254 only active accent and send button. Flat surfaces, restrained 6-8px control radii, composer 12px, no gradients, no glass, no card-inside-card. Compact UI labels 13-14 px equivalent, chat body 15-16px, page titles at most 22px. Icons thin consistent line icons. All navigation/actions are real functional affordances, not decorations. Preserve Cairn wordmark as text, do not use Claude's logo or add invented marketing claims.

Shared exact Chinese content: session title "优化桌面端设计"; navigation "对话", "插件", "记忆", "自动化"; primary sidebar action "新任务"; project "Cairn"; section label "今天"; session list "优化桌面端设计" (selected), "梳理项目结构", "检查工作区改动"; bottom "设置". Top-right only two quiet text actions "改动" and "工具". Main chat: small user bubble aligned right says "优化桌面端设计，现在的内容太丑了"; understated assistant identification "Cairn", with clean left aligned text "先统一桌面端的布局、字体和控件。" then three calm short lines "收敛导航入口", "统一页面与阅读层级", "保留项目和会话上下文". Under it one collapsed process disclosure row with chevron and small terminal icon reading "查看界面与组件". No large assistant avatar. Plenty of calm space beneath conversation while keeping content visually anchored, no huge greeting. Bottom composer aligned to chat reading width, modest border, actual input placeholder "描述任务，/ 调用技能，@ 引用文件". Composer bottom controls "+", "引导", "方案", "DeepSeek", and one terracotta upward-arrow send button. Show no fabricated test results, download counts, or testimonials. Make Chinese text exact and crisp. All regions must look like one beautifully coherent native desktop product.
COMPOSITION A — unified sidebar, recommended. One single 248px-wide sidebar containing EVERYTHING in a clear vertical hierarchy, no additional left icon rail: top wordmark "Cairn" and discreet collapse button, then a medium quiet "新任务" button and search icon, then four icon + text global navigation rows with "对话" selected, a subtle 24px gap, then project "Cairn" with chevron and three sessions. Settings pinned at sidebar bottom. Main remaining 1192px has a slim 48px top contextual header with left session title and right two actions. Conversation centered at 760px reading width. User bubble near upper right, response below, composer pinned with 28px bottom gap. This must look calm, finished, dense enough for serious work. No duplicated workspace or page title. No right panel in default view.
status: exploratory; superseded by user-provided Codex screenshots for the recommended direction
